description: This Java source file defines a Hibernate interceptor class 'DropMillisecondsHibernateInterceptor' that removes milliseconds from Date fields before saving or updating database records to ensure compatibility with MySQL versions prior to 5.6, which do not support millisecond precision in DATETIME fields.

classes.name: DropMillisecondsHibernateInterceptor
classes.description: A Hibernate interceptor that truncates milliseconds from Date fields before saving or updating entities, to maintain compatibility with older MySQL versions that do not support millisecond precision in DATETIME columns.

methods.name: onFlushDirty
methods.description: Overrides Hibernate method; invoked when an entity is updated, removes milliseconds from Date fields in currentState.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Overrides Hibernate method; invoked when an entity is saved, removes milliseconds from Date fields in state.

methods.name: removeMillisecondsFromDateFields
methods.description: Private helper method that processes an array of field values, truncating milliseconds from Date objects where present.
